title: Docker Mod manifest (mod.yml)
description: One per mod branch in docker-mods. The hub indexes every branch's mod.yml to build the mods API and site.

name.description: Mod name without the image prefix, e.g. 'python3'.

target.description: Image the mod applies to, or 'universal'.

bases.description: Base families the mod handles; universal mods usually list alpine and ubuntu.

images.description: Images the mod is recommended for besides its target, by image name. A universal mod lists the images where it is useful; the hub links the mod from those images' pages and run examples.

upstream.description: The upstream a mod packages, for mods that pin a tool version. The build passes the resolved version as the MOD_VERSION build arg and tags it; the control plane checks it hourly and builds the mod when that version has no tag yet.

version.description: The same source types as image.yml, resolved by the same resolver. Not os, command or deb_repo: the scheduler runs none of those.
Superseded by upstream.version and read by nothing; removed at the next MAJOR.
